detail.longDescription: tmux status-interval 1 had six #() programs for statusbar, on battery that was 15.4% of a core. After digging found fork+exec through sh -c is ~14.6 ms and computing the actual segments was 2.6 ms on my device. Plus had ~1.5k lines of zsh scripts. Now one deamon process, caches in memory, unix socket and one #() for the whole right side. From 153.77 ms/s → 18.43 ms/s. Made that into a tmux plugin. You can try it without installing/configuring: docker run --rm -it lonkarorg/tmux-companion:playground
